/**
 * Dataset-agnostic chatbot service with JavaScript calculations + Groq.
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * - No dataset names, worksheet names, column names, questions, or answers
 *   are hardcoded.
 * - Exact numeric answers are calculated by JavaScript from the rows received
 *   in the current request.
 * - Groq is used only to understand the question and to answer general
 *   non-dataset questions.
 * - Supports one worksheet or multiple worksheets.
 *
 * Accepted input:
 *
 * 1. One worksheet:
 *    await answerQuestion([{...}, {...}], question)
 *
 * 2. Multiple worksheets:
 *    await answerQuestion({
 *      SheetA: [{...}, {...}],
 *      SheetB: [{...}, {...}]
 *    }, question)
 *
 * 3. loadDivisionData()-style values:
 *    await answerQuestion({
 *      SheetA: { rows: [{...}], ...metadata },
 *      SheetB: { rows: [{...}], ...metadata }
 *    }, question)
 */

const GROQ_URL = "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions";
const GROQ_MODEL =
  process.env.GROQ_MODEL || "llama-3.3-70b-versatile";

const MAX_SCHEMA_EXAMPLES = 8;
const MAX_LOOKUP_ROWS = 50;
const MAX_RESULT_ROWS = 100;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 10;

const OPERATION_ALIASES = {
  sum: ["sum", "total", "combined", "overall", "altogether"],
  average: ["average", "avg", "mean"],
  median: ["median", "middle value"],
  minimum: ["minimum", "min", "lowest", "smallest", "least"],
  maximum: ["maximum", "max", "highest", "largest", "greatest"],
  row_count: ["row count", "number of rows", "how many rows", "records", "entries"],
  distinct_count: ["unique", "distinct", "different"],
  list: ["list", "show", "display", "enumerate", "what are", "which are"],
};

function normalizeText(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[’']/g, "")
    .replace(/&/g, " and ")
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s._%()/+-]/gu, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function tokenize(value) {
  return normalizeText(value)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function parseNumber(value) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    String(value).trim() === ""
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  let text = String(value).trim();
  const isNegativeWithParentheses =
    text.startsWith("(") && text.endsWith(")");

  text = text
    .replace(/,/g, "")
    .replace(/%/g, "")
    .replace(/[^\d.+-]/g, "")
    .trim();

  if (!text || text === "-" || text === "+" || text === ".") {
    return null;
  }

  const number = Number(text);

  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
    return null;
  }

  return isNegativeWithParentheses
    ? -Math.abs(number)
    : number;
}

function formatNumber(value) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value);
}

function safeRows(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.filter(
      (row) => row && typeof row === "object" && !Array.isArray(row)
    );
  }

  if (
    value &&
    typeof value === "object" &&
    Array.isArray(value.rows)
  ) {
    return value.rows.filter(
      (row) => row && typeof row === "object" && !Array.isArray(row)
    );
  }

  return [];
}

function asDatasetMap(input, fallbackName = "Dataset") {
  if (Array.isArray(input)) {
    return {
      [fallbackName]: safeRows(input),
    };
  }

  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") {
    return {};
  }

  const datasets = {};

  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
    const rows = safeRows(value);

    if (rows.length > 0) {
      datasets[String(name)] = rows;
    }
  }

  return datasets;
}

function getColumns(rows) {
  const columns = new Set();

  for (const row of rows || []) {
    for (const key of Object.keys(row || {})) {
      if (String(key).trim()) {
        columns.add(key);
      }
    }
  }

  return [...columns];
}

function getNonBlankValues(rows, column) {
  return rows
    .map((row) => row?.[column])
    .filter(
      (value) =>
        value !== null &&
        value !== undefined &&
        String(value).trim() !== ""
    );
}

function inferColumnType(rows, column) {
  const values = getNonBlankValues(rows, column);

  if (!values.length) {
    return "empty";
  }

  const numericCount = values.filter(
    (value) => parseNumber(value) !== null
  ).length;

  if (numericCount / values.length >= 0.7) {
    return "number";
  }

  const dateCount = values.filter((value) => {
    const text = String(value).trim();

    if (!/[/-]/.test(text)) {
      return false;
    }

    const timestamp = Date.parse(text);
    return !Number.isNaN(timestamp);
  }).length;

  if (dateCount / values.length >= 0.7) {
    return "date";
  }

  return "text";
}

function uniqueValues(rows, column, limit = MAX_SCHEMA_EXAMPLES) {
  const result = [];
  const seen = new Set();

  for (const row of rows) {
    const raw = row?.[column];

    if (
      raw === null ||
      raw === undefined ||
      String(raw).trim() === ""
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    const displayValue = String(raw).trim();
    const key = normalizeText(displayValue);

    if (!seen.has(key)) {
      seen.add(key);
      result.push(displayValue);
    }

    if (result.length >= limit) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function buildSchema(datasets) {
  return Object.entries(datasets).map(([name, rows]) => {
    const columns = getColumns(rows);

    return {
      name,
      rowCount: rows.length,
      columns: columns.map((column) => ({
        name: column,
        type: inferColumnType(rows, column),
        examples: uniqueValues(
          rows,
          column,
          MAX_SCHEMA_EXAMPLES
        ),
      })),
    };
  });
}

function normalizedSimilarity(left, right) {
  const a = normalizeText(left);
  const b = normalizeText(right);

  if (!a || !b) return 0;
  if (a === b) return 1;
  if (a.includes(b) || b.includes(a)) {
    return Math.min(a.length, b.length) /
      Math.max(a.length, b.length);
  }

  const aTokens = new Set(tokenize(a));
  const bTokens = new Set(tokenize(b));
  let intersection = 0;

  for (const token of aTokens) {
    if (bTokens.has(token)) {
      intersection += 1;
    }
  }

  const union = new Set([...aTokens, ...bTokens]).size;
  return union ? intersection / union : 0;
}

function findDatasetName(datasets, requestedName) {
  const names = Object.keys(datasets);

  if (names.length === 1 && !requestedName) {
    return names[0];
  }

  if (!requestedName) {
    return null;
  }

  const ranked = names
    .map((name) => ({
      name,
      score: normalizedSimilarity(name, requestedName),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  return ranked[0] && ranked[0].score >= 0.5
    ? ranked[0].name
    : null;
}

function findColumn(rows, requestedColumn) {
  const columns = getColumns(rows);

  if (!requestedColumn) {
    return null;
  }

  const ranked = columns
    .map((column) => ({
      column,
      score: normalizedSimilarity(column, requestedColumn),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  return ranked[0] && ranked[0].score >= 0.45
    ? ranked[0].column
    : null;
}

function requireColumn(rows, requestedColumn, label = "Column") {
  const column = findColumn(rows, requestedColumn);

  if (!column) {
    throw new Error(
      `${label} "${requestedColumn || ""}" was not found. ` +
      `Available columns: ${getColumns(rows).join(", ")}`
    );
  }

  return column;
}

function compareValue(actual, expected, operator = "equals") {
  const leftText = normalizeText(actual);
  const rightText = normalizeText(expected);
  const leftNumber = parseNumber(actual);
  const rightNumber = parseNumber(expected);

  switch (operator) {
    case "contains":
      return leftText.includes(rightText);

    case "starts_with":
      return leftText.startsWith(rightText);

    case "ends_with":
      return leftText.endsWith(rightText);

    case "greater_than":
      return (
        leftNumber !== null &&
        rightNumber !== null &&
        leftNumber > rightNumber
      );

    case "greater_or_equal":
      return (
        leftNumber !== null &&
        rightNumber !== null &&
        leftNumber >= rightNumber
      );

    case "less_than":
      return (
        leftNumber !== null &&
        rightNumber !== null &&
        leftNumber < rightNumber
      );

    case "less_or_equal":
      return (
        leftNumber !== null &&
        rightNumber !== null &&
        leftNumber <= rightNumber
      );

    case "not_equals":
      return leftText !== rightText;

    case "equals":
    default:
      return leftText === rightText;
  }
}

function normalizeFilter(rows, filter) {
  if (!filter || typeof filter !== "object") {
    return null;
  }

  const column = findColumn(rows, filter.column);

  if (!column) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    column,
    operator: filter.operator || "equals",
    value: filter.value,
  };
}

function applyFilters(rows, filters = []) {
  const normalizedFilters = (Array.isArray(filters) ? filters : [])
    .map((filter) => normalizeFilter(rows, filter))
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (!normalizedFilters.length) {
    return rows;
  }

  return rows.filter((row) =>
    normalizedFilters.every((filter) =>
      compareValue(
        row?.[filter.column],
        filter.value,
        filter.operator
      )
    )
  );
}

function inferImplicitFilters(
  question,
  rows,
  excludedColumns = []
) {
  const normalizedQuestion = normalizeText(question);
  const excluded = new Set(excludedColumns.filter(Boolean));
  const candidates = [];

  for (const column of getColumns(rows)) {
    if (excluded.has(column)) {
      continue;
    }

    const type = inferColumnType(rows, column);

    if (type === "number") {
      continue;
    }

    const values = uniqueValues(
      rows,
      column,
      Math.max(rows.length, 1)
    );

    if (values.length > 2000) {
      continue;
    }

    for (const value of values) {
      const normalizedValue = normalizeText(value);

      if (
        normalizedValue.length >= 2 &&
        normalizedQuestion.includes(normalizedValue)
      ) {
        candidates.push({
          column,
          operator: "equals",
          value,
          score: normalizedValue.length,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  const selected = [];
  const usedColumns = new Set();

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (!usedColumns.has(candidate.column)) {
      selected.push(candidate);
      usedColumns.add(candidate.column);
    }
  }

  return selected.map(({ score, ...filter }) => filter);
}

function mergeFilters(
  plannedFilters,
  inferredFilters
) {
  const result = [];
  const seen = new Set();

  for (const filter of [
    ...(Array.isArray(plannedFilters) ? plannedFilters : []),
    ...(Array.isArray(inferredFilters) ? inferredFilters : []),
  ]) {
    if (!filter) continue;

    const key = [
      normalizeText(filter.column),
      filter.operator || "equals",
      normalizeText(filter.value),
    ].join("|");

    if (!seen.has(key)) {
      seen.add(key);
      result.push(filter);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function getLimit(plan) {
  const value = Number(plan?.limit);

  if (!Number.isInteger(value)) {
    return DEFAULT_LIMIT;
  }

  return Math.min(
    Math.max(value, 1),
    MAX_RESULT_ROWS
  );
}

function median(values) {
  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const middle = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);

  if (sorted.length % 2 === 0) {
    return (
      sorted[middle - 1] + sorted[middle]
    ) / 2;
  }

  return sorted[middle];
}

function formatFilterDescription(filters = []) {
  if (!filters.length) return "";

  return (
    " where " +
    filters
      .map(
        (filter) =>
          `${filter.column} ${filter.operator || "equals"} "${filter.value}"`
      )
      .join(" and ")
  );
}

function executePlan(datasets, rawPlan, question = "") {
  const plan = {
    ...rawPlan,
    operation: normalizeText(rawPlan?.operation).replace(/\s+/g, "_"),
  };

  let datasetName = findDatasetName(
    datasets,
    plan.dataset
  );

  if (!datasetName && Object.keys(datasets).length === 1) {
    datasetName = Object.keys(datasets)[0];
  }

  if (!datasetName) {
    throw new Error(
      `The requested dataset was not found. Available datasets: ` +
      `${Object.keys(datasets).join(", ")}`
    );
  }

  const rows = datasets[datasetName];
  const resolvedColumn = plan.column
    ? findColumn(rows, plan.column)
    : null;
  const resolvedGroupBy = plan.groupBy
    ? findColumn(rows, plan.groupBy)
    : null;

  const inferredFilters = inferImplicitFilters(
    question,
    rows,
    [resolvedColumn, resolvedGroupBy]
  );

  const filters = mergeFilters(
    plan.filters,
    inferredFilters
  );

  const filteredRows = applyFilters(rows, filters);
  const filterText = formatFilterDescription(filters);
  const limit = getLimit(plan);

  if (plan.operation === "row_count") {
    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: "row_count",
      value: filteredRows.length,
      filters,
      answer:
        `There are ${formatNumber(filteredRows.length)} record(s) ` +
        `in ${datasetName}${filterText}.`,
    };
  }

  if (
    plan.operation === "list" ||
    plan.operation === "distinct_count" ||
    plan.operation === "non_empty_count"
  ) {
    const column = requireColumn(
      rows,
      plan.column,
      "Column"
    );

    const values = filteredRows
      .map((row) => row?.[column])
      .filter(
        (value) =>
          value !== null &&
          value !== undefined &&
          String(value).trim() !== ""
      );

    if (plan.operation === "non_empty_count") {
      return {
        success: true,
        source: "dataset",
        dataset: datasetName,
        operation: "non_empty_count",
        column,
        value: values.length,
        filters,
        answer:
          `There are ${formatNumber(values.length)} populated ` +
          `${column} value(s) in ${datasetName}${filterText}.`,
      };
    }

    const distinctValues = [];
    const seen = new Set();

    for (const value of values) {
      const displayValue = String(value).trim();
      const key = normalizeText(displayValue);

      if (!seen.has(key)) {
        seen.add(key);
        distinctValues.push(displayValue);
      }
    }

    distinctValues.sort((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b)
    );

    if (plan.operation === "distinct_count") {
      return {
        success: true,
        source: "dataset",
        dataset: datasetName,
        operation: "distinct_count",
        column,
        value: distinctValues.length,
        filters,
        answer:
          `There are ${formatNumber(distinctValues.length)} unique ` +
          `${column} value(s) in ${datasetName}${filterText}.`,
      };
    }

    const shown = distinctValues.slice(0, limit);

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: "list",
      column,
      count: distinctValues.length,
      results: shown,
      filters,
      answer:
        `${column} values in ${datasetName}${filterText}:\n` +
        shown
          .map(
            (value, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ${value}`
          )
          .join("\n") +
        (
          distinctValues.length > shown.length
            ? `\n...and ${formatNumber(
                distinctValues.length - shown.length
              )} more.`
            : ""
        ),
    };
  }

  if (plan.operation === "lookup") {
    const selectedColumns =
      Array.isArray(plan.selectColumns) &&
      plan.selectColumns.length
        ? plan.selectColumns
            .map((column) =>
              findColumn(rows, column)
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
        : getColumns(rows).slice(0, 10);

    const shown = filteredRows.slice(
      0,
      Math.min(limit, MAX_LOOKUP_ROWS)
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: "lookup",
      count: filteredRows.length,
      results: shown,
      filters,
      answer:
        `I found ${formatNumber(filteredRows.length)} matching ` +
        `record(s) in ${datasetName}${filterText}.\n` +
        shown
          .map(
            (row, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ` +
              selectedColumns
                .map(
                  (column) =>
                    `${column}: ${row?.[column] ?? ""}`
                )
                .join(", ")
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  if (plan.operation === "group_count") {
    const groupColumn = requireColumn(
      rows,
      plan.groupBy,
      "Group column"
    );

    const groups = new Map();

    for (const row of filteredRows) {
      const label = String(
        row?.[groupColumn] ?? ""
      ).trim();

      if (!label) continue;

      groups.set(
        label,
        (groups.get(label) || 0) + 1
      );
    }

    const results = [...groups.entries()]
      .map(([label, value]) => ({
        label,
        value,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
      .slice(0, limit);

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: "group_count",
      groupBy: groupColumn,
      results,
      filters,
      answer:
        `Record count by ${groupColumn} in ${datasetName}` +
        `${filterText}:\n` +
        results
          .map(
            (item, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ${item.label}: ` +
              `${formatNumber(item.value)}`
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  const numericColumn = requireColumn(
    rows,
    plan.column,
    "Numeric column"
  );

  const numericRows = filteredRows
    .map((row) => ({
      row,
      value: parseNumber(row?.[numericColumn]),
    }))
    .filter((item) => item.value !== null);

  if (!numericRows.length) {
    throw new Error(
      `No numeric values were found in "${numericColumn}"` +
      `${filterText}.`
    );
  }

  if (
    ["sum", "average", "median"].includes(
      plan.operation
    )
  ) {
    const values = numericRows.map(
      (item) => item.value
    );
    const sum = values.reduce(
      (total, value) => total + value,
      0
    );

    let value;

    if (plan.operation === "average") {
      value = sum / values.length;
    } else if (plan.operation === "median") {
      value = median(values);
    } else {
      value = sum;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: plan.operation,
      column: numericColumn,
      value,
      recordsUsed: values.length,
      filters,
      answer:
        `The ${plan.operation} ${numericColumn} in ${datasetName}` +
        `${filterText} is ${formatNumber(value)}, based on ` +
        `${formatNumber(values.length)} record(s).`,
    };
  }

  if (
    ["minimum", "maximum"].includes(
      plan.operation
    )
  ) {
    numericRows.sort((a, b) =>
      plan.operation === "maximum"
        ? b.value - a.value
        : a.value - b.value
    );

    const labelColumn = plan.groupBy
      ? requireColumn(
          rows,
          plan.groupBy,
          "Label column"
        )
      : null;

    const results = numericRows
      .slice(0, limit)
      .map((item) => ({
        label: labelColumn
          ? item.row?.[labelColumn]
          : null,
        value: item.value,
        row: item.row,
      }));

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: plan.operation,
      column: numericColumn,
      value: results[0]?.value,
      results,
      filters,
      answer:
        `${plan.operation === "maximum" ? "Highest" : "Lowest"} ` +
        `${numericColumn} in ${datasetName}${filterText}:\n` +
        results
          .map(
            (item, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ` +
              (
                item.label !== null &&
                item.label !== undefined &&
                String(item.label).trim() !== ""
                  ? `${item.label}: `
                  : ""
              ) +
              formatNumber(item.value)
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  if (
    [
      "group_sum",
      "group_average",
      "group_minimum",
      "group_maximum",
    ].includes(plan.operation)
  ) {
    const groupColumn = requireColumn(
      rows,
      plan.groupBy,
      "Group column"
    );

    const groups = new Map();

    for (const item of numericRows) {
      const label = String(
        item.row?.[groupColumn] ?? ""
      ).trim();

      if (!label) continue;

      if (!groups.has(label)) {
        groups.set(label, {
          sum: 0,
          count: 0,
          minimum: item.value,
          maximum: item.value,
        });
      }

      const group = groups.get(label);
      group.sum += item.value;
      group.count += 1;
      group.minimum = Math.min(
        group.minimum,
        item.value
      );
      group.maximum = Math.max(
        group.maximum,
        item.value
      );
    }

    const results = [...groups.entries()]
      .map(([label, group]) => {
        let value;

        switch (plan.operation) {
          case "group_average":
            value = group.sum / group.count;
            break;
          case "group_minimum":
            value = group.minimum;
            break;
          case "group_maximum":
            value = group.maximum;
            break;
          default:
            value = group.sum;
        }

        return {
          label,
          value,
          recordsUsed: group.count,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
      .slice(0, limit);

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "dataset",
      dataset: datasetName,
      operation: plan.operation,
      column: numericColumn,
      groupBy: groupColumn,
      results,
      filters,
      answer:
        `${plan.operation.replace("group_", "")} ` +
        `${numericColumn} by ${groupColumn} in ${datasetName}` +
        `${filterText}:\n` +
        results
          .map(
            (item, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ${item.label}: ` +
              `${formatNumber(item.value)}`
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported operation: ${plan.operation}`
  );
}

function extractJson(text) {
  const cleaned = String(text || "")
    .replace(/```json/gi, "")
    .replace(/```/g, "")
    .trim();

  const start = cleaned.indexOf("{");
  const end = cleaned.lastIndexOf("}");

  if (
    start === -1 ||
    end === -1 ||
    end <= start
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Groq did not return valid JSON."
    );
  }

  return JSON.parse(
    cleaned.slice(start, end + 1)
  );
}

async function callGroq(
  messages,
  options = {}
) {
  const apiKey = process.env.GROQ_API_KEY;

  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error(
      "GROQ_API_KEY is missing from the backend environment variables."
    );
  }

  const response = await fetch(GROQ_URL, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: options.model || GROQ_MODEL,
      temperature:
        options.temperature ?? 0.1,
      max_tokens:
        options.maxTokens || 900,
      messages,
    }),
  });

  const body = await response
    .json()
    .catch(() => ({}));

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      body?.error?.message ||
      `Groq request failed with HTTP ${response.status}.`
    );
  }

  return (
    body?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() ||
    ""
  );
}

async function createPlan(
  question,
  datasets
) {
  const schema = buildSchema(datasets);

  const systemPrompt = `
You are the intent detector and query planner for a dataset chatbot.

The chatbot receives one or more datasets. Each dataset may have completely
different names, columns, values, and subject matter.

Return JSON only. Never calculate the final numeric answer yourself.

Choose exactly one route:

1. Dataset calculation or lookup:
{
  "route": "dataset",
  "dataset": "exact dataset name",
  "operation": "sum|average|median|minimum|maximum|row_count|non_empty_count|distinct_count|list|lookup|group_count|group_sum|group_average|group_minimum|group_maximum",
  "column": "exact column name or null",
  "groupBy": "exact column name or null",
  "filters": [
    {
      "column": "exact column name",
      "operator": "equals|not_equals|contains|starts_with|ends_with|greater_than|greater_or_equal|less_than|less_or_equal",
      "value": "filter value"
    }
  ],
  "selectColumns": [],
  "limit": 10,
  "reason": "brief reason"
}

2. Dataset/schema question:
{
  "route": "schema",
  "intent": "datasets|columns|row_counts|find_column|describe",
  "column": "requested column name or null",
  "dataset": "requested dataset name or null"
}

3. General question:
{
  "route": "general",
  "reason": "brief reason"
}

4. Ambiguous dataset request:
{
  "route": "clarify",
  "question": "one concise clarification question"
}

Rules:
- Use only dataset and column names that appear in the supplied schema.
- Do not invent dataset names, column names, filters, or values.
- Exact totals, averages, rankings, counts, lists, and record lookups must use
  route "dataset".
- Questions about available datasets, worksheets, columns, row counts, or
  which dataset contains a column must use route "schema".
- Grammar, translation, definitions, explanations, writing, greetings, and
  general knowledge must use route "general".
- "How many rows/records/entries" means row_count.
- "How many values are filled in column X" means non_empty_count.
- "How many unique/distinct X" means distinct_count.
- "How many X" may mean sum when X is a numeric quantity column. Use the
  column type in the schema.
- "By", "per", or "for each" normally requires a group operation.
- Use lookup when the user asks to find, show, or retrieve matching records.
- If the request could refer to multiple datasets and the schema does not make
  the intended one clear, use route "clarify".
`;

  const response = await callGroq(
    [
      {
        role: "system",
        content: systemPrompt,
      },
      {
        role: "user",
        content:
          `DATASET SCHEMA:\n${JSON.stringify(schema)}\n\n` +
          `USER QUESTION:\n${question}`,
      },
    ],
    {
      temperature: 0,
      maxTokens: 900,
    }
  );

  return extractJson(response);
}

function answerSchemaQuestion(
  question,
  datasets,
  plan = {}
) {
  const schema = buildSchema(datasets);
  const intent =
    plan.intent || "describe";

  if (intent === "datasets") {
    return {
      success: true,
      source: "schema",
      operation: "datasets",
      results: schema.map((item) => ({
        name: item.name,
        rowCount: item.rowCount,
      })),
      answer:
        "Available datasets:\n" +
        schema
          .map(
            (item, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ${item.name} ` +
              `(${formatNumber(item.rowCount)} rows)`
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  if (intent === "row_counts") {
    return {
      success: true,
      source: "schema",
      operation: "row_counts",
      answer:
        "Dataset row counts:\n" +
        schema
          .map(
            (item, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ${item.name}: ` +
              `${formatNumber(item.rowCount)}`
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  if (intent === "find_column") {
    const requestedColumn =
      plan.column || question;

    const matches = schema
      .map((dataset) => ({
        dataset: dataset.name,
        columns: dataset.columns
          .filter(
            (column) =>
              normalizedSimilarity(
                column.name,
                requestedColumn
              ) >= 0.45
          )
          .map((column) => column.name),
      }))
      .filter(
        (item) => item.columns.length > 0
      );

    if (!matches.length) {
      return {
        success: false,
        source: "schema",
        operation: "find_column",
        answer:
          `I could not find a column matching "${requestedColumn}" ` +
          `in the currently loaded datasets.`,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "schema",
      operation: "find_column",
      results: matches,
      answer:
        `Matching column locations:\n` +
        matches
          .map(
            (item, index) =>
              `${index + 1}. ${item.dataset}: ` +
              item.columns.join(", ")
          )
          .join("\n"),
    };
  }

  if (intent === "columns") {
    const requestedDataset = findDatasetName(
      datasets,
      plan.dataset
    );

    const selected = requestedDataset
      ? schema.filter(
          (item) =>
            item.name === requestedDataset
        )
      : schema;

    return {
      success: true,
      source: "schema",
      operation: "columns",
      answer: selected
        .map(
          (dataset) =>
            `${dataset.name} ` +
            `(${formatNumber(dataset.rowCount)} rows):\n` +
            dataset.columns
              .map(
                (column, index) =>
                  `${index + 1}. ${column.name} [${column.type}]`
              )
              .join("\n")
        )
        .join("\n\n"),
    };
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    source: "schema",
    operation: "describe",
    answer: schema
      .map(
        (dataset) =>
          `${dataset.name} contains ` +
          `${formatNumber(dataset.rowCount)} rows and ` +
          `${formatNumber(dataset.columns.length)} columns. ` +
          `Columns: ${dataset.columns
            .map((column) => column.name)
            .join(", ")}.`
      )
      .join("\n\n"),
  };
}

async function answerGeneralQuestion(
  question,
  datasets
) {
  const schema = buildSchema(datasets).map(
    (dataset) => ({
      name: dataset.name,
      rowCount: dataset.rowCount,
      columns: dataset.columns.map(
        (column) => ({
          name: column.name,
          type: column.type,
        })
      ),
    })
  );

  const answer = await callGroq(
    [
      {
        role: "system",
        content: `
You are a helpful general-purpose assistant inside a data chatbot.

You may answer general questions, definitions, explanations, grammar,
translation, writing, rewriting, and greetings.

Important:
- Do not invent exact values, totals, rows, rankings, or facts from datasets.
- You only know the dataset schema below, not every dataset value.
- When exact dataset data is required, state that the dataset engine should
  calculate it.
- Answer clearly and directly.
`,
      },
      {
        role: "user",
        content:
          `AVAILABLE DATASET SCHEMA:\n${JSON.stringify(schema)}\n\n` +
          `QUESTION:\n${question}`,
      },
    ],
    {
      temperature: 0.3,
      maxTokens: 1000,
    }
  );

  return {
    success: true,
    source: "groq",
    operation: "general",
    answer,
  };
}

function detectLocalOperation(question) {
  const normalized = normalizeText(question);

  for (const [operation, aliases] of Object.entries(
    OPERATION_ALIASES
  )) {
    if (
      aliases.some((alias) =>
        normalized.includes(alias)
      )
    ) {
      return operation;
    }
  }

  if (
    /\bhow many\b/.test(normalized) ||
    /\bnumber of\b/.test(normalized) ||
    /\bcount\b/.test(normalized)
  ) {
    return "row_count";
  }

  return null;
}

function createLocalFallbackPlan(
  question,
  datasets
) {
  const operation =
    detectLocalOperation(question);

  if (!operation) {
    return null;
  }

  const candidates = [];

  for (const [datasetName, rows] of Object.entries(
    datasets
  )) {
    for (const column of getColumns(rows)) {
      const score = normalizedSimilarity(
        question,
        column
      );

      candidates.push({
        datasetName,
        column,
        score,
        type: inferColumnType(rows, column),
      });
    }
  }

  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  const best = candidates[0];

  if (
    !best ||
    best.score < 0.2
  ) {
    if (
      operation === "row_count" &&
      Object.keys(datasets).length === 1
    ) {
      return {
        route: "dataset",
        dataset: Object.keys(datasets)[0],
        operation: "row_count",
        column: null,
        groupBy: null,
        filters: [],
        limit: DEFAULT_LIMIT,
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  let resolvedOperation = operation;

  if (
    operation === "row_count" &&
    best.type === "number" &&
    !/\b(rows?|records?|entries)\b/.test(
      normalizeText(question)
    )
  ) {
    resolvedOperation = "sum";
  }

  return {
    route: "dataset",
    dataset: best.datasetName,
    operation: resolvedOperation,
    column:
      resolvedOperation === "row_count"
        ? null
        : best.column,
    groupBy: null,
    filters: [],
    selectColumns: [],
    limit: DEFAULT_LIMIT,
  };
}

/**
 * Main exported function.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: this function is asynchronous.
 */
async function answerQuestion(
  input,
  question,
  options = {}
) {
  if (
    !question ||
    !String(question).trim()
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      answer: "Please enter a question.",
    };
  }

  const datasets = asDatasetMap(
    input,
    options.datasetName || "Dataset"
  );

  if (!Object.keys(datasets).length) {
    try {
      return await answerGeneralQuestion(
        question,
        {}
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        source: "system",
        operation: "error",
        answer:
          "No dataset is currently available, and the general AI service " +
          `could not respond. Details: ${error.message}`,
      };
    }
  }

  try {
    const plan = await createPlan(
      question,
      datasets
    );

    if (plan.route === "clarify") {
      return {
        success: false,
        source: "router",
        operation: "clarify",
        answer:
          plan.question ||
          "Please specify the dataset or column you want to use.",
      };
    }

    if (plan.route === "schema") {
      return answerSchemaQuestion(
        question,
        datasets,
        plan
      );
    }

    if (plan.route === "general") {
      return await answerGeneralQuestion(
        question,
        datasets
      );
    }

    if (plan.route === "dataset") {
      return executePlan(
        datasets,
        plan,
        question
      );
    }

    throw new Error(
      `Unsupported route: ${plan.route}`
    );
  } catch (primaryError) {
    console.error(
      "Primary chatbot routing failed:",
      primaryError
    );

    const fallbackPlan =
      createLocalFallbackPlan(
        question,
        datasets
      );

    if (fallbackPlan) {
      try {
        return executePlan(
          datasets,
          fallbackPlan,
          question
        );
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        return {
          success: false,
          source: "dataset",
          operation:
            fallbackPlan.operation || "unknown",
          answer:
            `I found a likely dataset request, but could not complete it. ` +
            `Details: ${fallbackError.message}`,
        };
      }
    }

    try {
      return await answerGeneralQuestion(
        question,
        datasets
      );
    } catch (generalError) {
      return {
        success: false,
        source: "system",
        operation: "error",
        answer:
          "I could not process the question. " +
          `Routing error: ${primaryError.message}. ` +
          `General AI error: ${generalError.message}.`,
      };
    }
  }
}

module.exports = {
  answerQuestion,
  asDatasetMap,
  buildSchema,
  executePlan,
  answerSchemaQuestion,
};
